ChoiceText.SourceString: I’m looking into Charles Reinold. Have you noticed anything strange about his prices?
ChoiceText.LocalizedString: I’m looking into Charles Reinold. Have you noticed anything strange about his prices?

CompletionText.SourceString: Marek Tholy, a regular customer of Charles’s shop, confirmed that he’s noticed rising prices. He mentioned that Charles often labels regular books as “special editions” to justify the higher costs. Marek also recalled a suspicious incident where Charles claimed a book was sold out, even though Marek had seen it on the shelf the day before.
